reason: Layers, port adapters, sqlite confinement, injected policy and bus-based events all follow the architecture; the store has no hidden adapter construction.
The api talks only to the application, the schedule is used through its exported names, sqlite3 stays in its adapter, and every adapter is built in wiring.
InMemoryPatientStore offers find() instead of the get() required by the PatientStore port, so this adapter does not satisfy its port.
BookingService.move assigns appointment.slot directly instead of going through the appointment's move_to method.
InMemoryAppointmentStore constructs its own OutboxNotifier adapter inside the adapter layer, not in wiring.py or via injection.
